The role will lead a global team to foster strong pre-service training, ongoing professional development, teacher coaching, leadership and career development, cohort culture, and systems for monitoring, evaluation, and learning across these functions within 60+ partner organizations and 30 prospective partners. •

description:

title: User Data Growth Analytics Lead
description:
Drive user growth by turning analytics into business impact
At Resmed, you’ll transform how we understand and grow our connected-device user base. As the User Data Growth Analytics Lead, you’ll lead the measurement framework that explains what drives user engagement, retention, and expansion-and how those dynamics connect directly to demand and revenue. In this role, you’ll help Resmed make smarter, faster decisions about how to grow value across millions of active users.
You’ll collaborate across Finance, Product, and Commercial teams to connect insights from our digital ecosystem, including myAir and AirView, with the financial performance that drives our continued growth. Your analysis will shape trusted metrics, forecasting models, and next-generation analytics products that help connect patient engagement to commercial outcomes.
You’ll bring a consumer-first lens to healthcare, building experimental approaches that move quickly from analysis to action. This is your chance to help Resmed evolve the way we measure and grow user outcomes-by teaching us new ways to think about engagement and retention.
What you’ll do

•
Define the analytics foundation - Own and evolve the measurement framework for our user base, shaping clear KPIs for engagement, retention, and experience enhancement across connected platforms.

•
Tell the story behind the data - Build cohort and lifecycle analyses to explain user behaviors, identify growth opportunities, and clarify what drives retention or churn.

•
Translate insight into financial impact - Link user dynamics to commercial performance, connecting engagement and retention metrics directly to demand and revenue outcomes.

•
Drive cross-functional visibility, insights, and accountability - Partner across Product, Marketing, Finance and Commercial teams to analyze business performance, identify drivers of growth and retention, and align actions to improve outcomes. Elevate actionable insights to leadership to inform strategic decisions, drive cross-functional accountability, and strengthen business performance.

•
Shape scalable data products - Collaborate with Data and Technology partners to improve data quality, streamline KPI governance, and develop reliable, curated datasets and dashboards that enable self-service analytics across teams.

•
Move fast, measure impact, and evolve - Discover opportunities in the data, test hypotheses, measure results, and quickly refine strategies based on what the insights reveal.

•
Build agile forecasts and size opportunities - Develop models to measure potential impacts of strategic efforts-estimating how movement in retention, resupply, or engagement metrics could translate into revenue uplift or cost efficiency.

•
Drive accountability through always-on measurement - Create visibility with regular tracking and interpretation of performance trends. Go beyond reporting, explaining why metrics shift and what actions should follow.

•
Champion thought leadership - Represent Retain & Expand analytics in leadership forums, act as a strategic partner in business planning, and guide discussions on how to measure success across Resmed’s evolving user base.
What you bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field

• 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, growth, or user analytics, including leadership of complex analytical programs or teams

• Expertise with large longitudinal datasets, lifecycle and retention analysis, and driver-based forecasting

• Advanced SQL and analytical skills, with proficiency in Power BI/Tableau, Excel, Python, or similar tools

• Strong business and financial acumen, capable of translating behavioral data into forecast impact

• Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and influence decision-making through clear, data-driven narratives

• Comfort working in ambiguity, curious mindset, and collaborative style that turns analytics in

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

- Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

- Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

- Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

- Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

- Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

- Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

- A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

- The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

- Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LL

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Zen team, you will be responsible for building the systems that help keep counterfeit items off Vinted, while protecting legitimate sellers.

Zen sits in the Trust domain and owns the counterfeit detection problem end to end, not just the tools. We combine rules, machine learning and modern AI to find counterfeit listings, understand where detection falls short and keep improving it. The work has a direct impact on how safe and trustworthy Vinted is for our members, and we're growing our use of AI to make that protection work at Vinted's scale.

We work with Go, Ruby and Python, alongside ML models and LLMs.

In this position, you’ll 

• Design and build the backend services behind counterfeit detection.

• Build AI-driven capabilities, including LLM-based systems, that are reliable, observable and cost-aware.

• Collaborate with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and bringing engineering input to how detection and models are improved.

• Measure the impact of what we ship, with accuracy and fairness to legitimate sellers in mind.

• Raise the bar for engineering and agentic development by mentoring engineers in the team and beyond.

About you 

• Proven experience designing, building and operating ML- and data-driven backend systems in production, with Go, Ruby or Python, including event-driven systems.

• Curiosity and drive to explore and apply AI to counterfeit detection, staying on top of the latest developments in LLMs and their practical applications.

• Solid understanding of data, ML and LLMs: how models are trained, evaluated and retrained, and how to build reliable systems around them.

• Comfortable working with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and contributing valuable engineering input.

• Demonstrated ability to own complex, ambiguous problems end to end and drive technical decisions.

• Pragmatic about trade-offs between catching abuse and protecting legitimate sellers, and able to explain technical decisions to non-engineers.

Collaborates with Project Manager, Safety/Pharmacovigilance (PvG), Data Management, Biostatistics, QA, Principal Investigator and Sub-investigators, Site Coordinators, the Data Monitoring Committee (DMC), and any other group that directly or indirectly protects the safety of study participants.

Clinical Trial Medical Oversight: Provide medical, scientific, and safety oversight for clinical trials, ensuring protocol adherence, participant safety, eligibility, IP dosing, and management of AEs/SAEs/SUSARs, with 24/7 coverage and backup support as needed.
Safety Review & Risk Management: Lead and support ongoing safety data review, including medical coding, patient narratives, Risk Management Plans, MedWatch reporting, and collaboration with Safety/PvG, DMCs, and cross‑functional teams.
Site & Investigator Support: Serve as the primary medical point of contact for investigators, site staff, and sponsors; participate in site selection, SIVs, investigator meetings, site visits, and protocol deviation and root‑cause assessments.
Data & Document Review: Conduct regular medical review of clinical data, CRFs, medical plans, informed consent forms, and study documents; contribute to Investigator’s Brochure content and interpretation of early‑phase trial data.

title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

- Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

- Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

- Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

- Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

- Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

- Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

- Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

- Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

- Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

- A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

- Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

- Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

- Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

- Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

- Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

- Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

- Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

- Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer

- The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

- A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

title: Technical Accounting Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

You will be the hands-on technical accounting expert who turns complex, fast-moving transactions into clear US GAAP conclusions that hold up under a PCAOB-standard audit. You will own accounting memos and policies, lead auditor discussions on the areas you own, and build the controls and documentation that let a young, global company report with confidence.

This is a builder role. Many of our policies are being written for the first time, our entity footprint is expanding across Europe, the Americas and APAC, and we are mid-ERP implementaion. You will shape how we account for all of it, not just maintain what exists.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Research, document and conclude on complex transactions under US GAAP, writing clear, audit-ready memos.

- Own accounting policies for key areas, including revenue (ASC 606: contract modifications, credits and concessions, multi-element SaaS arrangements), leases (ASC 842, including incremental borrowing rate), stock-based compensation (ASC 718) and income taxes support (ASC 740) with our tax team.

- Support business combination accounting (ASC 805): purchase price allocation, valuation coordination with third-party specialists, and post-acquisition integration of acquired entities.

- Advise on intercompany and transfer pricing mechanics, foreign currency (ASC 830) and the accounting for new entities as we enter new markets.

- Monitor new and emerging standards and assess their impact on Legora.

- Act as a primary point of contact for our external auditors on your areas: prepare support, answer technical questions and resolve findings.

- Manage and review the work of external technical accounting and valuation advisors, keeping deliverables on time and in scope.

- Design and document controls over technical accounting areas and non-routine transactions, in partnership with internal audit.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 7+ years of accounting experience, starting in Big 4, with a few years in a technical accounting or financial reporting role in industry.

- CPA or an equivalent qualification.

- Deep, current US GAAP knowledge, especially ASC 606, 842, 718 and 805, and a track record of writing memos that auditors accept.

- Hands-on experience with PCAOB-standard audits and SOX or ICFR controls over technical areas.

- Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency group, including consolidation and intercompany.

- Clear writing and the judgment to explain a complex position simply to auditors, executives and non-finance partners.

- Comfort working with ambiguity in a fast-scaling company, and the drive to build processes from scratch.

NICE TO HAVE

- Expe

title: Site Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. The fleet you run will draw more power than some countries, on the way to 10s of GW.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Sites come online in pieces, and you keep the live ones running flawlessly while construction continues around them.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. No prior operations org has run at this speed and scale, so the standards you set become the standard.

ROLE SCOPE

- Lead 24/7/365 operation of all critical infrastructure at your site: electrical distribution (UPS, generators, switchgear), mechanical and liquid cooling, fire/life safety, and building controls, accountable for availability against customer SLAs.

- Own site safety in partnership with HSE, including hazardous energy control, electrical safety, and LOTO discipline across a mixed employee and contractor workforce.

- Build and lead the full site team, facility operators alongside hardware and network operators, owning shift coverage, on-call rotations, performance, and development.

- Run the hardware and network repair operation: own the ticket queues, drive triage, prioritization, break-fix, and RMA workflows, and hold time-to-repair against customer commitments as the fleet scales.

- Run incident and change management for the site: lead severity response as the escalation point, deliver root cause analyses on 5 and 10 day clocks, and drive corrective actions that fix classes of problems, not instances.

- Partner with construction, commissioning, colo providers, and utilities while the site is live and still being built, driving operational readiness, MOP and SOO rigor, and clean handover into operations.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Overview
Patchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code. That product is early. We have good signals from hosts and hackathons, but we haven't yet found who it serves best, what they value, or why they'll keep paying for it.
You'll be the product manager who finds that out. You'll talk to customers, use the product in real AI-assisted workflows, test ideas quickly with our designer and engineers, and build the measurement that tells us what's working. You'll work alongside two small engineering squads, a senior product designer, QA and infrastructure. You own which customer problems we invest in and how we learn from the results.
About you
You're happiest early, before the answers exist. You'd rather run a small test this week than wait for perfect data. You're comfortable in a terminal and have built things with AI-assisted tools, so you can use our product the way our customers do. You form your own view on technical claims rather than taking "it's not feasible" or "the metric improved" at face value. You say what you think, including when it's awkward, and you change your mind when the evidence says so. You work well in a flat team with little process, and you help people around you get better rather than taking work off them.
Responsibilities

• Run customer discovery for the JavaScript product: interviews, observed usage, support and event feedback, and your own hands-on use.

• With Growth and Product Marketing, recommend which customers and problems to focus on, backed by evidence of who uses, who pays and why.

• Shape what we build with the Senior Product Designer from early discovery through testing. You own the problem and intended outcome; they own the design response.

• Agree outcomes and priorities with the engineering squads and help them turn validated problems into work. Squads own delivery.

• Build and ship small prototypes, experiments and product changes yourself where that's the fastest way to learn, within our review and QA process.

• Own product measurement in PostHog: define the actions that matter, get tracking in place, and combine the numbers with customer evidence to explain what's working.

• Keep what we've learned, decided and assumed visible in Notion so the team can make good investment calls.

• Raise risks, gaps and decisions early, and escalate anything beyond your remit.

Requirements

• Experience as a product manager on a technical or developer-facing product, ideally pre or early product-market fit.

• Examples of changing or stopping a product direction based on customer and technical evidence you gathered yourself.

• Hands-on with AI-assisted development, the command line, packages and dependencies. You don't need to be a production engineer, but you need to be at home in that environment.

• Strong customer research and data analysis skills, including building useful measurement from little reliable data.

• Clear, direct communication with designers, engineers and leadership in a remote, low-process team.

Benefits

• €75-100k salary, depending on location and experience, plus company stock options

• 4.5-day working week (half-day Fridays)

• Remote-first, with reasonable overlap with EU timezones

• 38 days' paid time off a year (including public holidays) plus 3 health days

• Company laptop, and co-working membership or home-office equipment

• AI tooling budget

• Quarterly health and wellness allowance

• Travel for conferences, events and our annual company meetup

- Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it.

- Make the client enterprise-ready: TLS and certificate handling, authentication including Microsoft Entra ID, safe credential handling, signed and reproducible packages, and the audit and compliance questions large .NET shops ask before they adopt.

- Shape the client for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

- Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks.

- Fluent in C#, and productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++). You'll review and co-own across clients, not only .NET.

- You've built or substantially extended a library other engineers depend on, and shipped NuGet packages across .NET Framework and modern .NET. You treat breaking changes accordingly.

- Fluent in .NET data access (ADO.NET http://ADO.NET, Dapper, EF Core) and at home in the wider .NET ecosystem: ASP.NET http://ASP.NET Core, Aspire, NuGet.

- Security-minded. You've shipped a library into enterprise environments and know what security, compliance and procurement teams look for in a dependency.

description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role
We are seeking a highly experienced engineer to join our Edge Services team, responsible for building and evolving Megaport’s edge compute platform. This platform underpins our Virtual Network Function (VNF) products and the networking systems that power them globally.
In this role, you will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and cloud-native infrastructure. You will be a key technical leader shaping the compute and networking stack, driving architectural decisions, and ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance across our edge platform. Beyond deep technical contribution, you will act as a central advisor within your domain - guiding strategy, mentoring engineers, and influencing outcomes across teams.

title: Senior Fullstack Mobile Engineer
description:
ABOUT US:

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a seasoned Fullstack Mobile Engineer to help shape the core experience for thousands of restaurant teams. This is a senior role focused on building performant, polished applications across mobile platforms.

You’ll lead development of cross-platform features, collaborate closely with design and product, and contribute to shared backend components when needed. You should bring a strong product mindset, care deeply about developer experience, and be excited about building better software, faster.

This role is ideal for someone who has experience shipping real-world apps, and is looking to make high-impact technical decisions in a fast-moving team.

 

Our Tech Stack: We use Kotlin multiplatform and Jetpack Compose. Everything runs in GCP and our database it’s Postgres.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Work on the development of our app architecture across Android and iOS

- Design and implement shared business logic and client code, as well as platform-specific UI components where needed

- Work closely with designers, PMs, and other engineers to deliver intuitive, delightful product experiences

- Contribute to backend services where necessary, ensuring tight integration and performance across the stack

- Continuously improve build tooling, developer experience, and code quality

- Play a critical role in shaping how Tebi scales across new markets, languages, and user types

 

WHAT YOU BRING:

- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with deep expertise in mobile engineering

- Strong experience building and shipping Android apps; familiarity with iOS and multiplatform development patterns.

- Strong experience with Kotlin

- Comfortable owning architecture decisions and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship features

- A strong product mindset, you care about solving real problems for users, not just writing code

- Great communication skills and a pragmatic approach to building scalable systems

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

 

BENEFITS:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Lunch Provided in Office

- Team building events

- Unlimited time off

Note: Interviews will start after the 14th of September.

 

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

 

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.

Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises.

You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next.

What you will do

- Qualify - Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit.

- Run requirement workshops - Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria.

- Check feasibility - Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed.

- Drive the concept - Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place.

- Be the technical face to the customer - Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs.

- Close the loop - Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

What you bring

- 3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects

- You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line

- You have had your hands on robot cells, from grippers and vision to feeders, conveyors and safety, and you know what makes them run on the shop floor

- You walk through a plant, watch a process for ten minutes and see where automation pays off

- You lead conversations with confidence, whether with an operator on the line or the plant manager signing off the investment

- You think in structure: after your workshop, the team can build on what you captured

- You can sketch a layout or check reach in CAD or simulation (e.g. Autodesk Fusion, Visual Components)

- You speak German and English fluently and enjoy being on the road, around 30% of the time

- Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

- Know-how in machine tending, palletizing, assembly or pick-and-place is a plus

- Robot programming or system integrator experience is a plus

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us tha

title: Virtual Banker I - Detroit, MI
description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood through our commitment to hospitality. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As Virtual Banker I within Consumer Banking, you will represent our brand and culture with the utmost hospitality, using the latest banking solutions and cutting-edge financial technology combined with friendly and attentive service. You will engage clients over the phone through inbound calls, providing strong customer service. Your responsibilities include offering advice and sharing products and services to help them meet their financial needs, all while making them feel appreciated and embodying our commitment to being the bank for all.

Job Responsibilities

• Foster a welcoming atmosphere by delivering attentive and friendly service, acting with a client-first attitude, and collaborating with team members to provide the most appropriate solutions.

• Demonstrate a commitment to hospitality by consistently exceeding client expectations and creating a warm and inviting environment.

• Handle inbound calls to engage in meaningful conversations, identify financial needs, and offer personalized financial solutions.

• Cultivate strong client relationships through active listening, thoughtful questioning, and exceptional customer service, referring clients to our team of experts as needed.

• Guide clients in utilizing technology self-service options such as the Chase Mobile App, Chase.com, and ATMs to enhance their banking experience.

• Achieve or exceed performance metrics related to client engagement and referrals, while staying informed about Chase products, services, and industry trends.

• Resolve client issues promptly and with attention to detail, ensuring a consistent and positive client experience.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

• Demonstrated client-first attitude with the ability to create a hospitable and friendly experience.

• Strong relationship-building skills, showing genuine care and concern during client interactions.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage clients clearly and courteously over the phone and via email.

• Proficiency in quickly and accurately learning products, services, and procedures.

• Ability to work collaboratively as a team to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity.

• Commitment to operating within established risk parameters and compliance obligations, completing required training efficiently.

• Proven client service experience or comparable experience.

• High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

• Strong desire and ability to influence, educate, and connect customers to technology solutions.

• Experience adhering to banking policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

• Experienced in retail banking, financial services, or a consultative customer relationship role in related industries, such as hospitality service industries, with a proven track record of success in deepening client relationships and delivering results, including experience in cultivating relationships with affluent clients.

• College degree or military equivalent.

The opportunity to join a fast-growing Legal Tech company with an international and entrepreneurial environment.

These are multi-entity, multi-brand projects with significant technical, data, and project management interlock with senior customer executives. The Principal runs these projects personally rather than directing others to run them, but does not do it alone. In a heavy-duty shop, the biggest, most complicated job doesn’t go to whoever happens to be free. You take Fullbay ’s largest and most complex implementations and run them with your own hands, from the first scoping conversation through a stable go-live, with the technical depth to see what will go wrong before it does.
You’re the right fit if you have personally run complex data migrations and cutovers, not just managed them, and you can hold your ground with a customer’s CIO when a cutover gets hard. You bring the rigor to run several go-lives at once through clear gates, the honesty to report status as it really is, and the judgment to take the hardest work yourself. You also leave things better than you found them, with the playbooks, decision rights and standards that make the next implementation easier. If you want to own the biggest builds and build the team that will own them next, we’d like to talk.

title: Manager, Credit Risk Operations
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll own credit risk operations across Airwallex’s global product portfolio, helping assess prospective and existing merchants while balancing commercial growth with robust risk protection. You’ll evaluate exposure across cards, bank payments and local payment methods, and use data-driven insights to strengthen credit decisioning, monitoring and early-warning frameworks.

- Own credit risk exposure across Airwallex’s global product portfolio and payment acceptance channels.

- Drive KYB processes that support a diversified, high-quality merchant portfolio.

- Define and monitor global credit risk performance KPIs, reporting and dashboards to improve visibility into credit performance.

- Build and improve standard operating procedures for credit risk vetting, investigation and ongoing monitoring.

- Partner with Business Development, Legal, Compliance and Transaction Risk to balance commercial goals with risk mitigation.

- Strengthen risk awareness across global stakeholders and surface emerging risks across products and geographies.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience assessing counterparty or merchant credit risk.

- Deep understanding of credit fundamentals, including financial statement analysis, cash flow assessment, collateral structures and exposure management.

- Practical experience with ongoing credit monitoring, limit setting and early-warning frameworks for merchant portfolios.

- Strong understanding of payment flows and how settlement timing, reserves and chargebacks affect credit exposure.

- Experience identifying and escalating emerging credit risks across payment products and geographies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain credit findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities with precision and attention to detail.

- An ownership mindset: you take accountability, drive clarity and execute with urgency.

PREFERRED

- Advanced proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL.

- Familiarity with card brand monitoring, compliance and KYB/KYC requirements.

- Experience managing credit exposure for merchants or partners within fintech, payments or financial institutions.

- Background in regulatory compliance or operational risk management.

- A track record of defining and reporting KPIs to improve process performance.

- Deep understanding of payment processing systems and associated credit, fraud and operational risks.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

- Y

description:
🧬 About Sano
Mission; what we do

• accelerating the world’s transition to personalised medicine

Purpose; why we do it

• to speed up development of life-saving treatments for those with limited options

Vision; where we’re going

• become the world’s best source of patient-in-the-loop genomic and health data for precision medicine development

👉 Curious to dive deeper? Read more about what we do here
Headlines:

• Role - Partnership Channel Manager

• Salary - £50,000 - £60,000

• Location - UK (remote only)

We're looking for a Partner Channel Manager to build and run Sano's partner channel.
Sano Genetics helps pharmaceutical companies developing genetically targeted medicines find, engage and retain the right patients for medical research. We work with some of the largest pharma organisations in the world, on trials where a patient's genetics decide whether they can take part. Many of these patients have no approved treatment. Getting them into the right trial, at the right moment, is sometimes the only shot they have.
Much of that work runs through partners: genetic testing laboratories, holders of genomic data, and the contract research organisations (CROs) that run trials for sponsors. Our laboratory partners already bring Sano into trials, because their pitch and ours are the same. This is the first role dedicated to the channel.
You'll equip partner sellers to bring us into their deals, grow a network of partners whose offer fits with ours, and turn what they bring into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives. With CROs, you'll help their teams sell Sano alongside the trial sites they already run. The channel is early; you'll write its playbook rather than inherit one.
You'll report to the Director of Sales and work alongside our VP of Commercial and CEO, in a small, remote, high-trust team where everyone sells. Expect regular overlap into US hours and travel to partner meetings and conferences. The package is a base salary plus a variable element tied to partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.
How you’ll make an impact:

• Partner sellers bring Sano into more of their deals, because you know their territories, targets and the accounts where we help them win.

• Partner teams sell Sano alongside their own offer, using a pitch built on evidence, short training and joint account plans that you build with Marketing.

• Joint activity with partners, from conference slots to webinars, puts us in front of sponsors together.

• New laboratory and genomic data partners add to our deal flow, on terms you shape with commercial leadership.

• CRO teams position Sano with their site strategy, not against it, and CRO deals run on their own stages so we learn which routes work.

• Partner leads become qualified opportunities, each with a named programme, a named trial-team contact and a live conversation, and go to the right Account Executive.

• Partner revenue can be forecast like any other, because partner pipeline and attribution are accurate in HubSpot.

This job is for you if you:

• Have built and run a partner or channel programme - recruited partners, equipped their sellers, and can show what it produced.

• Sell well through other companies' sales teams, who have their own targets and little attention to spare.

• Understand how commercial decisions happen in clinical research - you know how sponsors, CROs and laboratories work together (who bids, who decides) from time in life sciences, diagnostics or clinical research.

• Can tell a real opportunity from a fishing expedition , and know when a deal needs an Account Executive, a scientist or a contract.

• Are curious enough about the science to be credible on trial phases, eligibility and genetic testing; no science degree needed.

• Bring strong commercial discipline - you write well, follow up, and keep a clean pipeline in HubSpot or similar.

• Work best in a remote team with clear intent and room to run, and use AI and automation to work smart.

title: Protection Scientist Engineer, Integrity
description:
About the Team

The Integrity team is responsible for the scaled systems that help identify and respond to bad actors and harm on OpenAI’s platforms. We protect users and the wider world by developing responses to complex harms and building the harm protections needed for new product and model launches. Integrity’s work spans not only across frontier harms like biological weapons and cybersecurity, but also high severity abuses such as child safety, nation-state misuse, and violence.

About the Role

Protection Scientists within Integrity design, orchestrate, and mature systems of defence against usage harms enabled by OpenAI's products. We are systems thinkers that combine deep harm domain expertise with breadth across investigation, data science, machine learning, policy and operations. Our distinctive strength is understanding how these disciplines fit together and translating between them to design and build effective systems of defence.

In San Francisco, we are hiring for protection work focused on sextortion, trafficking, national security (including nation-state misuse), and jailbreaks. Depending on your domain expertise, your work could include identifying AI-enabled coercion and exploitation, detecting misuse that supports trafficking, uncovering coordinated activity by state-linked actors, or investigating attempts to circumvent model safeguards. You will translate these evolving threats into detection systems and interventions that reduce harm.

Your core hands-on technical responsibility is harm detection. You will design, build, evaluate and maintain production detection systems, drawing on investigative expertise, data and shared engineering platforms. You will develop signals and classifiers that identify abusive behaviour and patterns across accounts and activity, and adapt them as adversaries change tactics.

You will also own the strategy and cross-functional delivery of protection work for a harm area or product launch. Working closely with investigators and other domain experts, you will ground the design in a deep understanding of how the harm occurs and translate that understanding into a system of defence. You will connect detection with policy, review, interventions, enforcement and measurement, continually calibrating the system against real cases and expert judgement as it scales.

You will identify what needs to be built or changed and make it happen. Success requires setting clear priorities, aligning partners, resolving dependencies and communicating evidence, decisions and trade-offs crisply. It also requires a willingness to jump in and work directly on whatever is blocking system effectiveness, using your breadth of skills.

This role is based in our San Francisco office and includes participation in an on-call rotation that may involve resolving urgent escalations outside normal working hours. Some investigations may involve sensitive content, including sexual, violent or otherwise disturbing material.

In this role, you will:

- Define and drive protection strategy for a harm area or launch. Translate ambiguous risks into goals, priorities and roadmaps, and make trade-offs based on evidence, risk and available capacity.

- Directly build and maintain harm detection. Develop production signals, classifiers and pipelines using SQL, Python, machine learning and language models, integrating with shared engineering platforms.

- Lead cross-functional execution. Translate between specialist roles, establish shared understanding and ownership, resolve technical and organisational dependencies, and communicate recommendations and specific asks clearly.
